paragraphs.text: Talrand is a Merfolk hydromancer and warlord who rules beneath the waves of the Kapsho Seas on Shandalar .
Talrand has blue skin and purple fins. He is powerfully built and wears the skull of a drake as a hat.

Talrand challenged the dominion of the dragon Kalyntri above the sea. The mage seems equally comfortable on the ground as in the seas, wields a large assortment of blue spells, and has the power to summon drake servants. The telepathic drakes serve him in exchange for his promise of an end to the tyranny of dragons. In a concerted effort, Talrand and a large flock of Drakes killed Kalyntri.

During the New Phyrexian Invasion , many drakes and merfolk died to protect their waters. After the war, the invasion damaged the natural barriers against the abyss, releasing horrors that had once been contained long ago in the sea. Talrand, seeing his rule of the sea threatened, is working on trying to contain them. Not only that, but he was forced to defend his territory from the surface as the humans of Shandalar, believing that the merfolk's control of the sea was weak, began to launch raids and take what they wanted.

After the Omenpath s began to appear on Shandalar, one was found on Mistral Island that Tarland claimed as part of his territory. He traveled through one though wound up in a terrible hot place place where even the grasses were made of spines and spikes. Tarland tried traveling through another zone path, but found the other side had a barrier and the people stated he could only cross unless he paid . The merman warlord thus returned to Shandalar didn’t really think much that the transplanar pathways would affect his people that much.

To protect the population of drakes, along with his daughter, from the new dangers, Tarland sought lakes large enough to safely house them. However, things changed when a letter arrived from Arcavios for his daughter with an invitation for her to attend its prestigious school.

With this better offer, Talrand sent his daughter Alandra to Strixhaven University on Arcavios. She is only allowed to return to Shandalar if she can show her father that she is strong enough to be his heir, wild enough to sculpt the storms, and clever enough to charm the drakes over to her side.
